title: GitHub sign-in got a proper home
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: cleaner GitHub auth, sturdier error handling, and a clearer map of what pollinations can grow.

GitHub authentication was fixed and moved to auth.pollinations.ai, with an admin endpoint added alongside it. Login plumbing is rarely glamorous, which is fortunate: it should mostly disappear.

Null-message handling was tightened up, while affiliate configuration received an update. Fewer strange empty-message failures; software continues its long campaign against missing values.

The AI Code Generator joined the project list, and the 1900 pitch deck was added to help tell the broader pollinations story.
